content: Replace the repository's implicit any-active-session scheduling and commit authority with one decision-authorized execution-focus contract. Make the default focus resolve to one active work item and one incomplete Exit Gate on a dependency-valid path; require every durable candidate commit to include its own in-progress owning session rather than borrowing an unrelated active session; keep closing records and explicitly governed migration/maintenance work bounded. Add validator, hook, self-test, documentation, current-progress, and active-session handoff coverage through D0029 and SC0006 without rewriting factual historical evidence.

D0029 replaces global any-active-session coverage with one machine execution focus: one exact in-progress owner, one dependency-valid product Exit Gate or one Active decision-bound governance migration, explicit METAFLUX_SESSION_ID at commit, exact non-owner record close, and atomic owner handoff.

Behavior revision 47d5735cb363129ac5877d084d0af1c4326c5421 added focus.json, schema/dependency/Exit-Gate validation, exact candidate-owner pre-commit authorization, Claude focus routing, compact current progress, and 184 self-test cases. Revision 51e0c7551ff8a41e241f952b8bea30e411bdc7d9 promoted the architecture to Verified.

Verification passed: Agent records, semantic-change 21/21, guidance 20/20, convergence inventory 15/15, skill routing 89-case corpus and 34/34 self-test, commit identity 7/7, focused architecture CTest 7/7, exact residual search, and nine unchanged Historical blobs.
